assets.initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one precise orthographic FRONT head-and-neck image for multi-view Hunyuan 3D reconstruction of Suzume Iwato from Suzume no Tojimari. The first input is the official face identity reference, second the film side reference, third the film rear reference. Create the same character, with MUCH higher facial likeness than a generic anime head. One single straight-on front view, centered, square white background, neutral eye-level orthographic camera, neutral closed mouth, calm expression. Show the COMPLETE scalp, two small ahoge strands, ears, all ponytail tips, entire slender neck down to clavicle; no shoulders, no clothing, no pedestal, no text. Adult-looking proportions must not be added: preserve the film character's youthful long oval face, soft pointed chin, large warm brown oval irises, delicate eyelids and lashes, small subtle anime nose and tiny natural mouth. Dark warm-brown hair, exact asymmetric split fringe and side locks. On HER LEFT temple (viewer RIGHT in this front view): a thin mustard-gold bar above TWO muted red pins crossing into an X. No pins on the opposite side. High tied ponytail originating behind the crown, falling down to below the neck, in coherent broad pointed hair locks as in the film back reference. The result should be a clean production-quality 3D anime head asset render with shallow sculpted facial features and restrained cel-like material shading, not a photo, not a porcelain doll, not a plush toy. Soft neutral studio light, even albedo colors, no dramatic shadows, no rim lighting, no metal shininess. Keep facial landmarks and hairstyle physically consistent for later left, right and back orthographic views. Hair and skin distinct, ponytail fully included without clipping, generous clean margins. Output 1024x1024.
